positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented initial API for AWM’s Frictionless shopping
experience in C# and deployed to Azure utilizing App Service, Azure SQL Server,
Service Bus, SignalR, Key Vault, and Redis. The API is responsible for handling
data coming from the Frictionless events, the user-facing mobile app, and
processing payments through multiple payment providers. Led efforts to redesign
the mobile app done in React Native to scale as a white-label app for multiple
clients.
● Used a combination of Python, C#, and Docker to build a scalable solution to
handle ingest of individual video frames from multiple cameras from Kafka and
Minio, encoding via ffmpeg, and egress to Azure Storage to be consumed as
VOD/Live video content.
● Mentored junior developers on fundamentals and coding practices via pair
programming, code reviews, and discussions on various topics.
● Used NodeJS, Typescript/Javascript, and React to build various internal tools to
aid in support of various department needs.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Architected the API in a NodeJS stack to support the business requirements set
out by the product owners.
● Utilized Elasticsearch for various search requirements: weighted searches based
on names and tags, review scores sort, distance weight and sort, and others.
● Set up continuous integration using CircleCI to deploy code and migrations to
AWS EC2/Postgres/Elasticsearch servers triggered via specific conditions from
Github.
● Worked with DevOps to build and test various scaling/deployment scripts for the
AWS ecosystem.

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
Develop curriculum and training program that all students go through to familiarize them with the technology stack that is used in client projects. 

Manage client projects to ensure that students can successfully complete a project.
Introduce students to industry practices such as integration and e2e testing and continuous deployment.

Lead development on projects across multiple Javascript stacks: React, React Native, NodeJS with deployment to through services such as CircleCI and AWS CodeDeploy.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Taught and helped develop the content and instruction for the full-stack bootcamp.
Managed and configured all server needs for company.
Designed and developed the backend to support the company’s tutorial platform using Laravel, Mongo, and MySQL.
Began rebuild of company’s tutorial platform in AngularJS.

positions.title: Senior Backend Developer
positions.description: Design/develop/update back-end systems (code and database schemas) from start to finish for clients and internal projects that include: automated ingestion and processing of data, development and implementation of first/third-party API services.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Designed and built application systems that consist of an API layer, a content management system, client applications on touch-screen monitors, and real-time updates of data and content pushed to any number of machines installed throughout the country. A combination of PHP, Java, C#, Flash Actionscript, and front-end technologies were used.
Recommended technologies and services to use for projects.
Mentored and reviewed code from junior developers. Led weekly developer meetings to introduce and explain methodologies and concepts to junior developers.
Attended strategy meetings with executive team and directors to help in planning upcoming projects.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed web API for mobile applications and games for iOS and Android devices using the Kohana Framework in PHP. Maintained an internal wiki of all API calls, code snipplets, security flows, and various other methodologies associated with the API.
Utilized Amazon's cloud computing services (EC2, S3, SES) to handle the processing and storage for the various mobile products.
Worked with RightScale to develop a scalable system to handle heavy traffic loads.
Researched noSQL and eventually integrated MongoDB for specific data storage and handling needs.
Led a team of five spread across iOS, Android and web platforms to develop a social media application.
